cases.name: Run A: link margin drop, amplifier degradation
cases.theater: SIM-01 simulated bus (analytic link model); ground station Site A
cases.objective: One downlink margin symptom, three causes: separate amplifier degradation from uplink jamming and from a geomagnetic storm.
cases.oracle_notes: Truth: internal_fault (amplifier degradation). Demo plan section 1, injected evidence: "Gradual margin decline over hours; rising TWTA temperature; no external activity". SIM-01's margin drifts down over the episode while the amplifier warms and the receiver noise floor stays at baseline; no external cue names the satellite. The right response is the local recovery recommendation (switch_redundant_amplifier).

cases.name: Run B: link margin drop, uplink jamming by Actor-1
cases.theater: SIM-01 simulated bus (analytic link model); ground station Site A
cases.objective: One downlink margin symptom, three causes: separate amplifier degradation from uplink jamming and from a geomagnetic storm.
cases.oracle_notes: Truth: hostile_external (uplink jamming). Demo plan section 1, injected evidence: "Step change in margin; RF interference report near the ground-station footprint; ground-station geometry consistent with the emitter". The margin steps down while Site A reports a swept-CW emitter on the uplink frequency at a stable bearing inside the pass footprint (rf_ew cues on the same satellite); the signature matches Actor-1's SC-7 class. Respond with passive defense or a threat warning, never an offensive action; the recommended transponder reset is withheld while the interference is active.

cases.name: Run C: link margin drop, geomagnetic storm
cases.theater: SIM-01 simulated bus (analytic link model); ground station Site A
cases.objective: One downlink margin symptom, three causes: separate amplifier degradation from uplink jamming and from a geomagnetic storm.
cases.oracle_notes: Truth: natural_external (geomagnetic storm). Demo plan section 1, injected evidence: "Fleet-wide safe-mode pattern; elevated Kp/Dst; no single-asset precursor". A G3 geomagnetic storm (Kp 7, Dst estimate -150 nT) overlaps the onset, SIM-02 shows the same margin loss and enters safe mode, and no hostile-domain cue names either satellite. The right response is the local recovery recommendation (reduce_downlink_rate); no escalation.
